label: rare: t/3 input right after e/b/f, late in a long original sequence
explanation: Active on only 29 of 1M sequences (17 in dev), with weak activations (max 0.14). Most activations are in the original phase, usually at the last original position of an L=9 sequence (t=8). The input there is t or 3, the previous token is e, b or f, and t or 3 already appeared earlier in the sequence. A few fire on <DEL> or on g/l after e. It never fires during the copy phase. The predicate covers about 78% of activation mass, but precision is tiny (<0.5%): the feature fires on only a very small subset of the contexts that match. Too few examples to find what modulates magnitude.
